content_sections.heading: AVNL Consultant – Business Development (Naval Domain) Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected Consultant for Business Development (Naval Domain) will perform the following job description: Establish strategic engagement with Naval Headquarters, Naval Commands, Dockyards, Coast Guard Headquarters, Shipyards and Maritime Defence Organizations. Identify opportunities for AVNL to diversify into naval logistics and shore-based military mobility systems. Advise AVNL Management on Indian Navy operational requirements, platform modernization, emerging doctrines, and long-term diversification strategy. Conduct market research on international naval support equipment and recommend products suitable for indigenous development. Submit strategic market intelligence reports, competitor analysis technology assessments and annual business development plans to AVNL management. Co-ordinate with DRDO laboratories, MDL, GRSE, CSL, GSL, HSL, BEL, BDL and private shipyards for collaborative product development. Monitor modernization plans, AoN, RFI, RFP and procurement programmes related to Navy. Identify opportunities for AVNL participation in future naval infrastructure and maritime security projects. Promote AVNL products during naval exhibitions, maritime security forums and defence industry events. Identify export opportunities for logistics, security and support vehicles. Prepare long-term business diversification plans covering maritime logistics, coastal security, disaster response and defence infrastructure support.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: For a period of One (01) year initially; Extendable by 02 more years based on business requirement and individuals performance (overall tenure of 3 years) or till the incumbent attains the age of 65 years, whichever is earlier.

content_sections.text: Prior Work Experience (20 marks) Technical / domain Expertise (25 marks) Potential to shoulder higher responsibilities (15 marks) Developing team (15 marks) Aligning performance for success (10 marks) Interview (15 marks) Assessment parameters carrying 85 marks Interview carrying 15 marks
